verdict.rationale: Jules is a general coding agent that clones repos, generates plans, produces diffs, and opens PRs from tasks/issues, but there is no evidence of any security-alert ingestion (e.g., Dependabot/CodeQL/SCA alert integration), automated validation of such alerts, or a workflow specifically triggered by security findings that opens a remediation PR. Missing for 10: security alert source integration, automated triage/validation logic, and any documented remediation-PR workflow tied to security scanning.
